note: Snapshot from main (beb4b9fc) before LM-378. These measures keep their meaning: the proto comment blocks and catalog entries must not change.

UNADJUSTED_COST_BASIS.name: UNADJUSTED_COST_BASIS
UNADJUSTED_COST_BASIS.description: The original purchase price of the security, before any adjustments for amortization, accretion, or corporate actions.
UNADJUSTED_COST_BASIS.formula: Returns the input price as-is (quoted as % of par for bonds)
UNADJUSTED_COST_BASIS.units: Quoted price (% of par for bonds; dollar price for equities)
model_assumptions: None — pass-through of the input price

INDEX_RATIO.name: INDEX_RATIO
INDEX_RATIO.description: The index ratio of a TIPS for the settlement date: reference CPI over the security's base CPI.
model_assumptions: Unfloored: the deflation floor applies to INFLATION_ADJUSTED_PRINCIPAL only

REFERENCE_CPI.name: REFERENCE_CPI
REFERENCE_CPI.description: The reference CPI of a TIPS for the settlement date (UTC date of ValuationRequestProto.asof_datetime), the numerator of the index ratio.
REFERENCE_CPI.formula: reference_cpi as given, or RefCPI = CPI(m-3) + (d - 1) / days_in_month * (CPI(m-2) - CPI(m-3)) from monthly readings
model_assumptions: Request rejected unless readings are exactly months m-3 and m-2 (UTC settlement month)
Absent when no CPI is given
